runtimeEnablementGates.required: Approve session/enrollment/challenge lifetime, attempt limits and recent-proof windows. Fixture values are illustrative.
Approve real capability/procedure, self/target policy, global revocation, result lookup and protected queued delivery. Three operations remain safely unavailable.
Approve onboarding/credential delivery; existing-identity references confer no identity creation authority.
Approve actual proof/reset/contact/notification procedure before enabling it. Guidance stays blocked.

Arrange real registry/history/result/audit/transaction/outbox providers before dependent durable actions. Reuse the canonical operation IDs, state/outcome semantics and requirement references; no fake stores or roadmap DAG changes.

compatibility.surface: Existing chapter HTTP transport and lookup
compatibility.classification: No change to retained enums/nullability/required fields/envelopes; P02 adds operation-specific unions, not new members to old envelopes.

compatibility.surface: Internal current context, identity/evidence and material references
compatibility.classification: Original internal contracts preserved. Public session uses a separate discriminated union; not a drop-in replacement. Internal MFA boolean is gate satisfaction, including not currently required, and does not assert factor proof. Separate public response uses explicit MFA status. Nullable incomplete policy material applies only to P02 policy roots; no legacy required-material relaxation.

compatibility.surface: IPC/RM, stock holds and canonical hashes
compatibility.classification: No schema/vector migration; original exact-value and canonicalization consumers remain authoritative at their own boundaries.
No health envelope/enum/nullability/required-field change. Existing real frontend TypeScript health client remains checked.

compatibility.surface: New session, administration, provisioning and unavailable identity-disable consumers
compatibility.classification: New auth-state/status unions require exhaustive consumers. Identity/provider operations do not fabricate chapter/versioned business success envelopes. Existing business ActionResult is unchanged. Schema ranges, regex formats, cross-field semantic equality and unknown-key rejection are not generally expressible by generated TypeScript.

limitations: Contract-only synthetic checks do not prove runtime authorization, MFA code consumption, session revocation, nonenumeration timing, atomic persistence or queued-output enforcement.
No P02 completion, AC-19/ADD-AC-09 runtime execution, live/MIG readiness or operational acceptance is claimed.

TypeScript preserves discriminants, required versions and string IDs where representable; runtime Ajv enforces formats/ranges/closed objects. Interval order, identity independence, scope binding, canonical material equality and durable replay need real server tests.

Historical Stage 0 evidence is preserved at its original revision and files; its original pending flags are not rewritten. The owner states Stage 0 is complete. This successor record changes neither historical execution results nor baseline acceptance.

Completed peer reviews are recorded from owner attestation; unresolved wire/security and runtime provider approvals remain visible and prevent independent implementation readiness claims for affected operations.
